references.title: 模拟法描绘静电场实验的主要误差来源分析
locators: p.22 section 1 equation (1), homogeneous concentric electrode potential
notes: Read all four PDF pages and checked rendered p.22 equation (1).
b is interpreted as the outer electrode inner-surface radius by the equation boundary r=b; the prose calls it an inner diameter.
Water/film observations and voltage shifts are not project calibration inputs.
references.application: p.22第1节式(1)给出同心电极间的理想电势：$U(r)=U_0\ln(b/r)/\ln(b/a)$。映射$a$为内柱电极半径、$b$为外环电极内表面半径、$r$为离中心的距离，$U_0$为内外电极电压差。原文正文将$b$称作内径，按式(1)边界$U(b)=0$及p.23图3/图5的径向区间，应作半径解释；项目不把直径代入该式。
